jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Requirements: 1-4 years of software engineering with production systems</p><p>Strong Python skills and full-stack fundamentals</p><p>Hands-on LLM experience in production</p><p>Built evaluation pipelines for AI systems</p><p>Fluency with AI tools and agents</p>

jobs.title: Customer Experience Engineer, L1
jobs.content: <p>Requirements: Up to 3 years relevant experience</p><p>Strong programming fundamentals with Python, JavaScript, or Java</p><p>Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications</p><p>Working SQL knowledge</p><p>Comfortable with rotational shifts and on-call coverage</p>

jobs.title: Customer Experience Engineer, L2
jobs.content: <p>Requirements: 3-7 years in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles</p><p>Strong debugging across APIs, distributed integrations, logs</p><p>Solid SQL and Python coding ability</p><p>Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth</p>

jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.content: <p>Requirements: 2-4 years data engineering experience</p><p>Working knowledge of OLAP databases like StarRocks</p><p>Some data lake technology experience</p><p>Familiarity with distributed query engines and Spark</p><p>Comfortable in AWS and open-source environments</p>

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer II
jobs.content: <p>Requirements: 3+ years DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering</p><p>Deep AWS expertise including EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, IAM</p><p>Strong Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux experience</p><p>Python or Java scripting skills</p><p>Solid grasp of cloud cost optimization</p>
